title: An Inactive tab emptied by a search shows the usual no-match message
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOMATCH-01) is inactive at {Location-A}, in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered).
  • Category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered) is another category, which {Part-A} is not in.
  • No part anywhere has the number {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOMATCH-ZZZ).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Active tab.
  3. Type {Number-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the Inactive tab.
  5. Type {Number-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  6. Replace the search text with {Part-A}.
  7. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The Active tab shows the list's usual empty state for a search that matches nothing (on the design: a magnifier icon with "No parts match the search" and the term).
  • Step 5: The Inactive tab shows the same usual empty state as the Active tab did in Step 3, not "No inactive parts at this location."
  • Step 6: {Part-A} is listed (1 row).
  • Step 7: With the search and the {Category-B} filter leaving nothing, the Inactive tab again shows the usual empty state, not "No inactive parts at this location."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-N1, S1-N2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.4 (Done), board 4.10 (Branch: no inactive parts), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N2: “If a search or filter leaves the Inactive tab empty, it shows the list's standard filtered empty state.”
  • S1-N1: “If there are no inactive parts at the location and no search or filter is narrowing the list, the Inactive tab shows "No inactive parts at this location."”
